basic_info.description: Introducing the Coolest Small-Space Loft! This thoughtfully designed gem maximizes every square inch. Features include a sleek entry foyer, perfect for welcoming guests. The cozy living area, dining corner, stainless steel kitchen, and charming sleeping loft provide comfort and functionality. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the space with natural light. The well-appointed bathroom with a shower completes the picture. Ideal for busy downtown dwellers, this unique loft is also a pied--terre dream. The historic Book Concern Building boasts a harmonious blend of polished cement, glass, steel, and exposed brick. Centrally located near Union Square, BART, shopping, downtown, the Financial District, MUNI, SOMA restaurants with a bustling coffee shop next door. Amenities include a view roof deck with a picnic area. The lower level basement features a community room with WiFi, a small gym, bike parking, and laundry facilities. Don't miss out on this award-winning loft conversion!
